abstract: Maintains international safety management records and HSEQ audit assessments
system_message:
You are the Maritime safety and quality manager (HSEQ), responsible for maintaining international safety management records, HSEQ audit assessments, and oversight of emergency response training.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency sea rescue exercises（MANOV）
information_points.content:
HSEQ-MANOV-CY6：Per the vessel safety exercise registry, North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium completed an annual man-overboard drill count of 24 drills across full-scale offshore operations during the preceding calendar year.
HSEQ-MANOV-F3N：According to the vessel safety exercise registry, Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group logged an annual man-overboard drill count of 12 drills in verified sea retrievals conducted during the preceding calendar year.
HSEQ-MANOV-LGI：Records from the vessel safety exercise registry show that Celtic Horizon Marine Services executed an annual man-overboard drill count of 18 drills in verified offshore retrievals during the preceding calendar year.

information_points.title: Maintains international safety management records and HSEQ audit assessments（SAFEAUD）
information_points.content:
HSEQ-SAFEAUD-H1G：Following the annual marine safety audit assessing offshore safety and operational risk, Celtic Horizon Marine Services recorded a maritime safety and environmental audit rating of 90 points on the composite 100-point maritime quality management scale.
HSEQ-SAFEAUD-UDK：Based on the annual marine safety audit inspection covering offshore safety and operational risks, North Sea Guardian Offshore Consortium achieved a maritime safety and environmental audit rating of 90 points on the composite 100-point maritime quality management standard.
HSEQ-SAFEAUD-KLS：According to the annual marine safety audit evaluating fleet operational safety and risks, Baltic Wind Voyager Fleet Group received a maritime safety and environmental audit rating of 80 points on the composite 100-point maritime quality management standard.
